authoring: Captured canine spine/head/vertical-body movement and measured four-paw footfall timing. Stride/contact/swing paths authored for the acquired Labrador proportions with C1 Hermite return, no-stretch anatomical fore/hind IK, bounded ear/tail follow-through. The delivered paw paths are fitted rather than a literal unmodified capture.

Root in place, finite full-skin samples, actual paw support/swing, loop position and tangent continuity, actual FBX roundtrip. Anatomical bend/contact drift independent audit recorded separately.
